subject: Question about the afternoon room change
text: Quick question about the logistics plan for next week, because I keep going back to the part where we assume the afternoon session can stay in the main room. What if we suggest moving it to the smaller workshop space near the east entrance instead? The benefit would be that attendees can hear the demo more clearly without the echo from the high ceiling, and we would also have room to set the laptop and portable projector on a low table near the front. I know that option makes people walk a little farther after lunch, but if we send a short reminder and add a printed arrow by the coffee station, it should still feel easy. My real concern is the speaker's notes, since they depend on having the microphone tested before the room fills up, and I would rather not have everyone waiting in the hallway while that gets sorted out. The alternative also keeps the main room free for the networking activity, which seems like the smoother sequence. Do you have any reason to keep the original setup, or should I draft a brief update to the schedule and flag the room change for approval? If you are fine with it, I can send the note after you look over the revised flow, and we can make the final call by end of day so we have time to adjust the signage.
